subject: [PATCH v9 13/32] mm/swap: allow duplicating a range of swap entries

2026-11-05.patch_summary: This patch allows duplicating a range of swap entries in the Linux kernel, rather than one at a time. This is necessary because some operations, such as PMD swap entry forks, require multiple slots to be duplicated simultaneously. The patch introduces new functions `swap_dup_entries_direct` and `swap_retry_table_alloc_nr` that take an additional argument for the number of entries to duplicate or allocate. It also adds inline wrappers for existing single-slot functions to maintain backwards compatibility. The range of entries must sit within a single cluster, and crossing ranges are rejected with an error code. No functional changes are intended by this patch.
